ContractScribe github-proposal

Usage:
  contract-scribe github-proposal start --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path> --github-configuration <path>
  contract-scribe github-proposal resume --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --configuration <path> --github-configuration <path>

Options:
  --repository-root <path>       Existing repository root.
  --input <path>                 Existing .sln, .slnx, or .csproj inside the repository.
  --policy <path>                Existing M1 policy file inside the repository.
  --snapshot <binding>           Caller-attested immutable snapshot binding.
  --state <path>                 Campaign checkpoint outside the repository.
  --configuration <path>         Strict non-secret campaign configuration JSON.
  --github-configuration <path>  Strict non-secret GitHub publication configuration JSON.
  -h, --help                     Print this help.

All seven options are required exactly once. Both --option value and --option=value forms are accepted in any order.

Environment:
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_PROVIDER_API_KEY  Existing campaign provider credential.
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_GITHUB_TOKEN      GitHub credential read once after local publication admission.

Exit codes:
  0  Published, replayed, no work, awaiting review, or merged.
  2  Invalid command-line usage.
  3  Bounded resumable conflict, rate limit, or stale base after creation.
  4  Invalid state or authority, human change, permission failure, or closed unmerged.
  5  Host failure.
  6  Cancelled.
  7  Timeout.
